title: EntityDetailsScreen
responsibility: The details screen of an entity of any kind: contract, measurements, and the source only when it is asked for.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.route
inputs.description: The address shown: category, entity, section and tab.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.scope
inputs.description: The branch and commit shown, and whether that is the branch tip or a selected commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.head
inputs.description: The revision every contract, measurement and capture on the screen is bound to.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.parent
inputs.description: The first parent of a selected commit; none at the branch tip and for a first commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.entities
inputs.description: The units of the shown revision as the explorer lists them.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.lens
inputs.description: What the host answers about an entity: relations, evidence, end-to-end results and history.

inputs.name: ExplorerScreenProps.onroute
inputs.description: Goes to another address of the explorer in the same branch and revision mode.

outputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.entityDetails
outputs.description: The contract, size and performance of an entity; measurements and the source by tab.

errors.name: no-registry
errors.description: A revision that stores no unit registry says so; nothing of another revision is shown.

errors.name: entity-missing
errors.description: An entity the shown revision does not hold is said to be missing, with the way back to its collection.
